name: io.github.R2Rlabs/hyperliquid-reins
title: Reins
description: Risk limits and an audit log for AI agents trading Hyperliquid, enforced outside the model.

environmentVariables.name: REINS_SYMBOLS
environmentVariables.description: Markets the agent may trade, comma separated, e.g. BTC,ETH. Every other market is refused.

environmentVariables.name: REINS_MAX_POSITION_USD
environmentVariables.description: Largest position per market, in USD.

environmentVariables.name: REINS_DAILY_LOSS_USD
environmentVariables.description: Realised loss in a UTC day after which new risk is refused.

environmentVariables.name: REINS_MAX_LEVERAGE
environmentVariables.description: Largest total exposure as a multiple of account value.

environmentVariables.name: REINS_MODE
environmentVariables.description: paper (live prices, simulated fills, nothing signed) or live.

environmentVariables.name: REINS_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Hyperliquid network for prices and, in live mode, orders. Mainnet spends real money.

environmentVariables.name: REINS_REQUIRE_STOP_LOSS
environmentVariables.description: true to refuse any order that adds risk without a stop-loss.

environmentVariables.name: REINS_LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Decision log, one JSON line per action with the agent's stated reason. In memory if unset.

environmentVariables.name: REINS_PAPER_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Where the paper account is kept between runs. In memory if unset.

environmentVariables.name: REINS_ACCOUNT_ADDRESS
environmentVariables.description: Live mode: the Hyperliquid account traded. Approve Reins' 2 bp builder fee from it first: npx @r2rlabs/reins approve-builder

environmentVariables.name: REINS_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Live mode: an API wallet's key, which can trade but not withdraw. Never the account's own key.
